cashflow.title: Choose one change to retirement contributions
cashflow.why: Retirement contributions and your tight monthly cash flow both draw on the same income.
steps: Check year-to-date 401(k) deferrals on your latest paystub
Call HR or plan rep to confirm remaining 401(k) deferral limit
Decide and set one change to your contribution this month

cushion.title: Separate and decide the home cash slice
cushion.why: Your January 2027 home and vacation needs push the cash target to $163,330 to $172,636.
steps: Confirm the cash target: $163,330–$172,636 for home and vacation
Move the exact amount you’ll need for January 2027 into a separate account
Leave remaining cash and long-term investments apart from that labeled account

debt.title: Keep paying the Amex down as planned
debt.why: Your Amex Platinum balance is $3,500 at 20% interest and is on track to clear by July 2028 if $200 monthly continues.
steps: Confirm the current Amex balance is $3,500 and interest is 20%
Ensure your $200 monthly payment is scheduled this month
If your cash allows, increase this month’s payment by a small amount
